description: Invoices with at least one transaction that is not a Payment. For each one, count all its transactions (Payments included) and show the top 10 by count.

a.request: Considering only transactions that have an invoice number, which invoice numbers have at least one transaction whose `transaction_type` is not exactly 'Payment'? For each such invoice number, show the invoice number and how many transactions in total carry it. Sort by that count from highest to lowest and return the top 10.
a.sql: SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type <> 'Payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 10

c.request: Ignoring transactions with no invoice number, which invoice numbers have transactions without the type 'Payment' (exact text)? Show each invoice number with the total number of transactions recorded for it. Sort by that count from highest to lowest and give the top 10. Invoices with at least one transaction that is not a Payment. For each one, count all its transactions (Payments included) and show the top 10 by count.
c.sql: SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL AND invoice_number IN (SELECT invoice_number FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL AND transaction_type <> 'Payment') GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: Invoices (excluding null invoice numbers) that have at least one transaction whose type is not exactly 'Payment', each shown with the count of all of their transactions (including Payment ones), sorted by that count descending, limited to the top 10.
b.sql: SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type <> 'Payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 10
b.raw: Invoices (excluding null invoice numbers) that have at least one transaction whose type is not exactly 'Payment', each shown with the count of all of their transactions (including Payment ones), sorted by that count descending, limited to the top 10.

d.request: Among Financial_Transactions rows with a non-null invoice_number, find the invoice numbers that have at least one transaction whose transaction_type is not exactly 'Payment', then for each of those invoices show the invoice number and the count of all its transactions (including Payment ones), sorted by that count descending, limited to the top 10.
d.sql: SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type <> 'Payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 10
